name: Instructions file
note: Markdown system prompt in the agent's folder
summary: The agent's identity, tone and standing rules live in a Markdown file inside the agent's own project, such as eve's agent/instructions.md, and the framework sends it as the system prompt on every model call. The file is versioned and deployed with the agent's code. Unlike AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, it describes the agent itself rather than a repository the agent works in.
how: Write identity, tone and standing rules in a Markdown file in the agent's folder
The framework loads the file as the system prompt when the agent is built
Every model call includes it, outside the conversation history
Move long or situational procedures into skills instead
facts: Plain Markdown; the file's text is the prompt
instructions/ directory, TypeScript modules, dynamic and user-role instructions
Reviewed with the code, but changes need a deploy
goodFor: Agents defined as a folder of files
watchOut: Changes reach the agent only with a new build or deploy
Long instructions cost context on every call
